metadata.title: The Atlas
metadata.description:
'The Atlas' is a 1 of 1 artwork inscribed on Bitcoin ordinals from the project 'The Wild Within', a series that brings new life into abandoned buildings from a bygone era.

  The artwork transitions between day and night modes at 7 am and 7 pm CEST, synchronized with the Bitcoin clock, reflecting the time zone of the abandoned building's location in Northern Italy.

  'The Atlas' is inscribed on a satoshi mined on March 24, 2021. This date marks the same day the first artwork from 'The Wild Within' was minted on Ethereum.

  Based on a real-world physical space, a rebirth into the digital realm is created by combining photography with three-dimensional techniques.

  The architecture depicted is the interior of an ornate abandoned villa, hidden in an overgrown plot of land near the coast of Genoa, Italy.

  The artists Ryan Koopmans & Alice Wexell have visited different locations around the world over the past decade, exploring architectural ruins and photographing structures that have undergone dramatic transition.

  Upon returning, they introduce digital vegetation, modify the structure and lighting, and alter the scenes with the intention of reviving the empty spaces, essentially bringing life back into the rooms.

  The results are a surreal collision between the past and future, natural and manmade, physical and digital, and the real and imaginary.

  The objective of this artwork is to depict a surreal representation of the cyclical essence of time. It delves into the theme of architectural history and its intricate connection with the natural world. Simultaneously, the intention is to permanently preserve the imagery on the blockchain.

  Many of the buildings depicted in 'The Wild Within' have been demolished in recent years, further emphasizing the theme of time passing in the cycle of growth and decay.

metadata.file_title: The Sky is Made Out of Waterfalls
metadata.context: There are days of no Rain. Of no Sun. Sometimes of everything and sometimes of nothing. Decisions taken are leading to outcomes that are beyond our wildest imaginations. Endless blocks of emptiness are suddenly filled with omnipresence. Emergence of an idea is taking shape of a snake - river, moving alongside the rocky pillars. Gaining speed and expanding width - daring its observers to catch the dip. Or is it a dip catching knives? Who would have taken the chance if not us? Out of nowhere, the river bed has expanded - culminated into a monsterfall. And so it might once again consume the Sky. To the Sky. Waterfall - TO THE SKY!

metadata.description:
Ordi Rune Gems - Moonstone: A Portal to Cosmic Wealth

Immerse yourself in the digital cosmos's vastness, where Moonstone not only serves as a beacon of beauty and mystery but also as a key to a universe where the ancient and digital converge in harmony. Embracing Moonstone embarks you on a journey filled with the promise of adventure and a treasure trove of runes, reborn on the bitcoin blockchain.

Earning Runes: The Journey Beyond the Halvening

The Epoch of Awakening: Holding Moonstone doesn't just make you a guardian of its beauty; it turns you into a beacon for accruing runes, essence from the digital cosmos. This exciting journey continues, reaching and even surpassing the monumental epoch known as the Halvening, at block 840,000, when the runes emerge anew.

A Celestial Airdrop: The journey begins with a celestial airdrop to the original guardians of the Ordinal realms. Those steadfast in the mysteries of the digital frontier will find 10,000 Moonstones cascading to them, each eager to find its keeper.

The Team's Pledge: With exploration and future voyages in mind, a small portion totaling 6% of this cosmic bounty is allocated to the team. This ensures the saga's continuation, with future value unlocked through giveaways and other exciting initiatives.

The Cosmic Accumulation: As each block in the bitcoin universe is mined, Moonstone holders will acquire a bounty of runes accumulating, a reward for their patience and devotion. This process continues, block by block, until the distribution reaches its celestial completion at an unknown time after block 840,000.

A Call to the Guardians: The adventure with Moonstone, laden with the secrets of the cosmos and the thrill of discovery, is calling. Are you prepared to step into the unknown and claim your place among the stars? The cosmic dance begins, and with Moonstone in hand, the universe is yours to explore.

metadata.Title: This Isn't Music
metadata.♫⋆｡♪˚♬⋆ ♪: Is a blue jay really real until it learns to sing?
metadata.♫⋆｡♪⋆ ♪˚♬: And are church bells really church bells before they even ring?
metadata.♫⋆˚♬｡♪⋆ ♪: Is that crescent moon still shining when the day begins to dawn?
metadata.♫⋆˚♬⋆ ♪｡♪: And tell me who would I be
metadata.♫⋆⋆ ♪｡♪˚♬: If I didn’t have a song?
metadata.♫⋆⋆ ♪˚♬｡♪: Where, oh where, oh where would I belong?
metadata.｡♪♫⋆˚♬⋆ ♪: This isn’t music, it’s my life
metadata.｡♪♫⋆⋆ ♪˚♬: It’s the teardrops in my eyes
metadata.｡♪˚♬♫⋆⋆ ♪: And the shivers down my spine
metadata.｡♪˚♬⋆ ♪♫⋆: The star that guides me home
metadata.｡♪⋆ ♪˚♬♫⋆: Til it finds the perfect words
metadata.˚♬♫⋆⋆ ♪｡♪: The best friend I’ve ever known
metadata.˚♬｡♪♫⋆⋆ ♪: So when my heart’s carried away
metadata.˚♬⋆ ♪｡♪♫⋆: And I’m waiting for a sign
metadata.⋆ ♪♫⋆˚♬｡♪: God I’m so bent out of shape
metadata.⋆ ♪｡♪˚♬♫⋆: Cause I got music on my mind
metadata.⋆ ♪˚♬♫⋆｡♪: So I’ll play you some music
metadata.♬⋆♪˚♬｡♪♫⋆: And I hope you’ll forgive me if I should lose it
metadata.♫⋆♪⋆♬⋆ ♪: Cause this isn’t music, it’s my life
